name: A01_3_the_reduction_is_exactly_one_generic
notes: Printed: 'Creature spells with flying you cast cost {1} less to cast.' Mistral Singer ({2}{U}) costs {1}{U} with the Watcher out: two mana. Seat 0 has ONE Island: the cast is refused (it would cost {U} only if the reduction were two). Then one {U} floats in the pool (the mana op) and the same cast succeeds with the Island and the pool: Island tapped, pool empty. The success is the control that the refusal was about the price.
